page_topic_one_liner: AI background changer tools — segmentation, matting, and scene replacement for photos

Background palette strip: four blurred scene swatches (pure white, gradient studio, outdoor park, prompt-generated sunset) as selectable chips
2x2 grid of before/after output pairs (product on white, portrait headshot, fashion ghost mannequin, pet on custom scene) — images only
Magnifying glass zooming on hair/fur matting edge where subject meets new background
anti_patterns: Single portrait with no cutout mask
Empty white placeholder cards below headline
